name: Encore Tracker
description: Syncs watch history to Encore. Each Jellyfin user connects with their own Encore URL and API key — no OAuth pairing ceremony required.

versions.changelog:
- Replace OAuth device-code pairing with simple URL + API key — no more approval ceremony
- Each Jellyfin user enters their Encore URL and an API key from Encore Settings → API Keys
- Remove ConnectionStore JSON file — config stored in standard Jellyfin XML plugin config
- Rename plugin display name to Encore throughout
- Existing users must re-pair after upgrade
